params.q: Which coaching institute did Ujjwal Priyank, UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 10, study at?

response.reconstructed_markdown:
Ujjwal Priyank, who secured All India Rank 10 in the UPSC CSE 2025, was associated with [VisionIAS](https://visionias.in/blog/english/ujjwal-priyank-air-10-upsc-2025-background-upsc-journey-marksheet-toppers-copy-strategy) for various test series and programs rather than a full\-time residential classroom program, relying heavily on systematic self\-study combined with test series. [0] [1]

### Association Details

- Test Series & Programs: He utilized the VisionIAS Abhyaas Prelims, Abhyaas Mains, Essay Test Series, Sociology Test Series, and the Personality Development Programme. [1]
- Preparation Strategy: His approach centered on structured test series for practice, standard textbooks, NCERTs, and rigorous answer\-writing focus alongside self\-study. [0] [2]
